description: Defines string manipulation functions for C-style strings, including duplication, comparison (case-insensitive), formatting, and scanning, with support for wide characters and conditional API versioning.

methods.name: SbStringDuplicate
methods.description: Duplicates a string, allocating memory that must be freed with SbMemoryDeallocate.

methods.name: SbStringCompareNoCase
methods.description: Compares two strings ignoring case differences.

methods.name: SbStringCompareNoCaseN
methods.description: Compares first 'count' characters of two strings ignoring case.

methods.name: SbStringFormat
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into a buffer, similar to vsnprintf.

methods.name: SbStringFormatWide
methods.description: Formats a wide-character string with variable arguments.

methods.name: SbStringScan
methods.description: Scans a string for a pattern, extracting values into provided arguments.
